About Canva:
Canva is on a mission to empower everyone in the world to design anything.

The Role:
Lead growth and subscription monetization experiments for millions of global users.

Responsibilities:
• Define product strategy and vision for subscription conversion and retention.
• Drive rigorous A/B testing, cohort analysis, and funnel optimization.
• Collaborate with globally distributed engineering, design, and marketing pods.

Requirements:
• 5+ years of product management experience with proven growth track record.
• Deep expertise in A/B testing, funnel analysis, PRD creation, and SQL.
• Remote work from anywhere in India.
